concerns.text: T014 (sample size validation) and T017 (save epochs) are marked incomplete, yet T018 (feature extraction) and downstream tasks depend on the output of T017 (`data/processed/epochs_cleaned.fif`). This creates a broken producer-consumer chain where the consumer (T018) is scheduled before its mandatory producer (T017) is complete.

T018 (Morlet decomposition) is marked incomplete/rejected, yet T023 (save features) and T025 (LDA training) depend on its output. The task list schedules consumers (T023, T025) before the producer (T018) is available, violating the data-flow dependency.

T028a (univariate t-tests) is listed as a producer for T029 (FWE correction), but T028a is marked incomplete. T029 cannot proceed without the input from T028a. Additionally, T028a depends on the feature matrix from T023, which depends on T018, creating a cascading dependency failure.

T004 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but the text explicitly states 'T004 must complete before T005'. A task cannot be parallel-safe if it has a hard sequential dependency on another task in the same phase. The [P] tag is incorrect for T004.

T010 is marked as a checkpoint for T011-T017, but T010 is also listed as part of the same phase. While the dependency is noted, the visual grouping suggests T011-T017 could start immediately after T009, potentially obscuring the strict T010 -> T011 dependency for parallel execution planning.
